description: This file contains CMake functions for configuring and installing header-only library components and package configuration files within a CMake-based build system. It defines functions to generate and install CMake package config files and pkg-config files, handling dependencies, templates, and target properties.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a CMake package configuration for a target, including versioning, dependencies, and target aliases.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config file for a specified target, including compile options, definitions, include directories, and libraries.
